data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E space and aerospace company that has raised $385M+ to date. The valuation analysis triangulates against a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (ICEYE at $12.0B Series F, Apex Space at $2.3B Series D, and Varda Space Industries at $1.6B Series D) and incorporates public Space & Aerospace comparables including RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, and SATL.

Two applicable methods were employed. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical for Series E advancement to the $385M capital raised proxy, yielding $539M. Peer-median valuation across the three private comparables produced $2.3B, with a range of $1.6B to $12.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (median 25.3x across 6 public tickers) was not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target. The peer set exhibits substantial dispersion, reflecting heterogeneity in business model maturity and market position within the sector.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods supports a valuation range of $458M (low) to $2.6B (high), with a median of $1.4B. Key uncertainties include Tomorrow.io's revenue scale relative to peers, profitability trajectory, and the wide valuation spread within the comparable set—particularly the $12.0B ICEYE outlier—which reflects stage and technology differentiation effects not fully resolved by current-stage proxy alone.
